coverageNote: The official Hahmlet v1.002 upstream variable TTF and static WOFF2 also support 2,788 Hangul syllables. Less common syllables, including U+B81F in the Korean font name, require the host Pretendard fallback. The original Google Fonts unicode-range declarations and binaries are preserved.
